title: 2017 AMC 10B Problem 9
statement: A radio program has a quiz consisting of \(3\) multiple-choice questions, each with \(3\) choices. A contestant wins if he or she gets \(2\) or more of the questions right. The contestant answers randomly to each question. What is the probability of winning?

solutions.text:
The probability that a contestant gets all \(3\) correct is \[\left(\dfrac13\right)^3=\dfrac1{27}.\] The probability of getting exactly \(2\) correct is \[\binom32\left(\dfrac13\right)^2\left(\dfrac23\right)=\dfrac6{27}.\] The combined probability is \[\dfrac6{27}+\dfrac1{27}=\dfrac7{27}.\]

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Count exactly three correct plus exactly two correct
For exactly two correct, choose which question is missed
